highroller.tip: Tuesday it runs noon–midnight but is shut to the public 4–7:30 PM for a private event, so a 9 PM ride is fine. Board by about 11. Smooth and slow, not a thrill ride.

sevenmm.how: No transit. Uber about 30 minutes each way; ask the driver to wait or book them for the return.
sevenmm.tip: No restrooms and no phone pickups out there, so never let the cab leave without a return plan. Bring water. On show through Dec 31, 2026.
sevenmm.entwhy: Dirt pull-off on Jean Dry Lake Rd; the cab waits here

DAYS.title: Arrival + center Strip
steps: Land at LAS. Cab to Circus Circus and drop your bags.
Deuce to the Venetian: Grand Canal, gondolas, St. Mark's Square. See Sphere from outside.
Walk back north via Wynn's flower lobby.
Check in. Sleep 3:30–6 PM; tonight is a short night.
Deuce south: Forum Shops at Caesars.
Bellagio Conservatory and fountain shows every 15 minutes.
Optional: Eiffel Tower deck over the fountains.
Back to the hotel to rest. Leave for the bus stop around 1:45 AM.

DAYS.title: LA: Universal, Hollywood, sunset
steps: Bus leaves Las Vegas (sleep on board).
Metro B Line to Universal City. Inside the park by ~9:20.
Universal no-coaster plan (see below) until 3:00 PM.
B Line one stop to Hollywood/Highland: Sign view, Walk of Fame, Chinese Theatre.
Sunset over the Pacific (6:08 PM). Pier lights come on.
Metro E Line from Downtown Santa Monica back toward downtown. Be at the bus stop by 11:45 PM.

DAYS.title: Hotel switch, early night
steps: Bus arrives. Back to Circus Circus to freshen up before work.
Check out; move bags across to Fontainebleau's bell desk (10 min walk). Check-in from 3 PM.
Optional easy stroll through Wynn & Encore. Otherwise sleep; you were on a bus last night.

DAYS.title: High Roller night ride
steps: Out after work. Walk to the Sahara monorail station (about 8 min).
Monorail from Sahara station to Harrah's/The LINQ.
High Roller night ride (30 min). Book ahead.
Walk the LINQ Promenade, grab a late bite.

DAYS.title: Old Vegas on Fremont
steps: Out after work. The Deuce stops on Las Vegas Blvd right outside.
Deuce north to Fremont Street Experience.
Canopy light shows, old casinos, live music on the street.

DAYS.title: South Strip walk
steps: Check out of Fontainebleau. Bags to Westgate (short cab or bell desk help). Check-in from 3 PM.
Monorail from Westgate to MGM Grand. Walk New York-New York, Excalibur, Luxor's beam.
Optional: see the Exosphere glowing on Metallica night (crowds).
Monorail back. Confirm your Saturday tour pickup tonight.

DAYS.title: Magic Mountains + Sphere
steps: Cab from Westgate, driver waits: Welcome sign photo stop.
Seven Magic Mountains, about 45 minutes. Bring water.
The Wizard of Oz at Sphere — 5 PM showing (there is no 3–4 PM show; the others are 2 PM and 8 PM). Halloween activities in the atrium.
Watch the Exosphere's evening show, dinner nearby.
Early night: tour pickup is about 6:30 AM.

DAYS.title: Grand Canyon West, then fly
steps: Check out; bags to Westgate bell desk. Small backpack only on the tour.
Tour pickup (spot set by your operator).
Hoover Dam bridge photo stop on the way back.
Halloween night on the Strip: costumes everywhere. Last fountain show.
Cab to the airport for the 11:59 PM flight.

see: Must see
#ff4fa3

RIDES: Tram through real backlots; small staged surprises, no drops.
Secret Life of Pets: Off the Leash
AR kart ride with turns; no drops or launches.
Theater film with gently moving seats.
Motion simulator. Ask staff for the stationary seats.
A small family coaster, about one minute. Your first test, if you want one.
Calm boat ride, then one big drop at the end. You will get wet.
New coaster: 72 mph, spinning cars, up to 3.6 G.
Intense robotic-arm motion; Hogsmeade is still worth walking.
LACARDS: From Hollywood & Highland's top-level walkway. One Metro stop from Universal.
Stars underfoot, movie-star handprints in the forecourt, Dolby Theatre next door.
Ferris wheel, arcade, Route 66 end sign, then sunset from the sand.
Easy dinner street next to the Metro station.
Best Hollywood Sign view, but costs ~90 minutes by DASH bus.
Boardwalk and skate park, 2 miles down the beach path.
AZCARDS: Pick “Grand Canyon West + Hoover Dam” with the Skywalk option, from about $200 depending on add-ons.
Pickups run about 5–7 AM depending on the operator; many collect at Sahara or Circus Circus around 6:30–6:50 AM, a short walk from Westgate. Confirm 48–72 hours ahead.
Shuttle loop to Eagle Point (Skywalk) and Guano Point. Lunch is often included.
Water, sunscreen, a light jacket (rim can be cool in late October), small backpack only.
